The offline force-layout bundle is generated from d3-force 3.0.0, with d3-dispatch
3.0.2, d3-quadtree 3.0.2, and d3-timer 3.0.2 bundled into one browser script.
The bundle has no runtime network or package-manager dependency. It exports
d3Force for graph.js.
SHA-256: `7e76940cc4fd363386a6b7f0ffb42dfb3a66e1dc9a406a1b8e6a94f2e54fda38`

Upstream source: https://github.com/d3/d3-force/tree/v3.0.0
The three dependency sources are maintained in the d3 organization:
https://github.com/d3/d3-dispatch/tree/v3.0.2
https://github.com/d3/d3-quadtree/tree/v3.0.2
https://github.com/d3/d3-timer/tree/v3.0.2

The license notices for each bundled project are in the matching `.LICENSE`
files in this directory. All are ISC licensed.
